name: frontend-spec-plugin
description: Turns product requirements, UI prototypes, and API contracts into an implementation-ready frontend specification.

interface.longDescription: A frontend-focused pipeline that structures product requirements, resolves ambiguities, parses UI prototypes, maps API contracts, designs interactions and flows, and assembles an implementation-ready specification without scanning the surrounding project or generating application code.
defaultPrompt: Turn this PRD, UI reference, and API contract into a frontend specification.
Find the missing decisions in this frontend requirement before development starts.
Update this frontend specification while preserving confirmed manual decisions.
